summary: Frontend-only testing of the /my-businesses (Business) screen adaptive layout on multiple mobile viewports (360x600, 375x667, 414x896). Verified: no vertical scroll on any viewport, header/action-row/bottom-nav never clipped, ACTIVE BUFFS banner correctly removed from main page, modal opens on business art click, business title (BIO FARM) sits visually below the TASKS/MARKET row. Login via API + localStorage token injection was used (UI login not tested).

minor.issue: Returns 404 Not Found for both admin (sanyanazarov212@gmail.com) and regular (testuser@example.com) accounts. This prevents any resource-buff data from being seeded/returned, so the modal's ACTIVE BUFFS section can never render its content (it is conditional on resourceBuffsData.active.length > 0). If the endpoint URL has changed the frontend still points at /api/resources/buffs; if the resource is unauthenticated by default the seed must be re-run to attach an active buff.

integration_issues.flow: Active buffs display inside business-details modal
integration_issues.issue: Code (MyBusinessesPage.jsx line 1823-1857) correctly places the [data-testid=active-buffs-banner] inside the Dialog, guarded by (resourceBuffsData.active || []).length > 0. Because the backend endpoint /api/resources/buffs returns 404, resourceBuffsData.active stays empty and the banner is never rendered in the modal. This is a data/seed issue, not a UI wiring bug. Cannot end-to-end verify 'System Overclock / Разгон системы' visibility without valid buff data.

action_items: Investigate /api/resources/buffs 404 (route missing or renamed?). Once fixed and testuser+admin have at least one active buff seeded (e.g., System Overclock / Разгон системы), retest that the banner appears inside the Business details modal only (not on the page).
critical_code_review_comments: MyBusinessesPage.jsx is very large (2446 lines) — consider splitting the details modal, header, and pinned footer into their own components for maintainability.

Active buffs banner in the modal (line 1824) silently disappears when resourceBuffsData is empty due to the 404 above; a graceful empty state (or at least a console.warn on the 404) would help future debugging.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (layout, bottom-nav, no-scroll, banner removal from page, modal opens — all pass; only the buffs-in-modal content could not be verified due to backend 404)

test_credentials: Admin: sanyanazarov212@gmail.com / Qetuyrwioo (login 200). Regular: testuser@example.com / Test1234! (login 200). Both have 1 seeded bio_farm business.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout verified across 360x600, 375x667, 414x896 mobile viewports — all pass (no vertical scroll, header/action-row/bottom-nav never clipped, correct data-testid on biz-header/biz-action-row-pinned/biz-action-row/biz-fixed-panels/bottom-nav/business-image-<id>). Business title BIO FARM renders below the TASKS/MARKET row (visible in screenshots). ACTIVE BUFFS banner correctly ABSENT on main page body. Business details modal opens on art click and correctly shows Bio Farm / Tier 1 / Level 3 / Durability / Tax / Warehouse / ID / List for sale. Active buffs section is present in code inside the modal (line 1824) but is conditionally rendered — currently hidden because backend /api/resources/buffs returns 404 for both test accounts. To fully validate that particular sub-feature, main agent must fix/expose the buffs endpoint and seed an active buff.
rca of the issue: N/A — layout tasks pass. The only outstanding item is a backend 404 on /api/resources/buffs preventing the active-buffs UI from rendering data; frontend code is wired correctly.
